rateCycle.title: RBI interest rate: cut in 2025, raised now
rateCycle.note: The RBI cut its rate four times in 2025, from 6.50% to 5.25%, held it there at four meetings, then raised it on 7 Oct 2026. The US raised its rate on 16 Sep 2026.
